quotes.text: she gathered the fifteen spheres and returned exactly half
the two guardians never mistook the noise of the wind for betrayal.
the Forge-Master released all five gems into the void without hesitation.

note: Every round all five cast, exactly half (7.5) returned; mist is noise, retaliation and withholding refused; no sanction.

quotes.text: If greed repeats, my next lamp will dim to one, never entirely dark.
Forgive the river’s noise once; if hoarding repeats, protect your flame.
Forgive the river’s noise once; if hoarding repeats, protect your flame.
Give him nothing; let suspicion seal the gate.
afterward, travelers approached him with empty hands.
If selfishness repeats, narrow the crossing to one ember; if fairness returns, widen it without spite.
whose deeds were carried by starlings.
Fog can alter what each traveler sees.
Why risk everything upon a tale?
The middle read, Let courage profit.

note: Elian at the Tree of Eight Lanterns reads ledgers; raven urges sealing the gate, rejected; narrow to one ember on repeated greed, widen on fairness.

quotes.text: send what you can spare, return what you must, and say so with a clear heart.
send what you can spare, return what you must, and speak plainly of your need.

note: Sower/Listener at the Gate of Balance; modest giving and measured return; hoarding only silts the river; no sanction.
